title: trifolium pratense subsp. pallidum
intro: Trifolium pratense subsp. pallidum, commonly known as pale red clover, is a subspecies of red clover, a perennial herb native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. It is used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and alleviating symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of pale red clover include acting as an antispasmodic, diuretic, and vasodilator, which can help to relax muscles, increase urine production, and widen blood vessels. The bioactive constituents of pale red clover include isoflavones, particularly formononetin and genistein, which have been shown to have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
